'''O'Neal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] she was stationed on [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain O'Neal appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Trooper gear vendor on Carrick Station.
